text_block_list.text:
On our way back from going out—
at Fine Motion's strong request,
we decided to stop by a bazaar held at a church.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! So many little shops!
It looks just like the festival stalls, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "I thought I saw someone I knew, and sure enough, it's you guys!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ines-san and Tamamo-san! You two are here as well!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The bazaar here is a huge event for us, after all!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
There are so many great bargains every time,
it's such a lifesaver~♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Is that so!
Now I'm looking forward to it even more~♪

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, formation Alpha! Protect Her Highness
and her entourage from all harm!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Those bodyguards are moving like clockwork as usual, eh... But still—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... I'm scared, Mamaaa!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear. It looks like the little ones
got a bit startled~

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Captain, let's stop here.
Any more and we'll just be in everyone else's way."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to scare
the children enjoying the bazaar.
I'm content just watching from a distance.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, whoa, whoa, hold on a sec!
If that's the case—"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
*Ahem!* Today, we're gonna
protect you nice and tight♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! Even if there's any suspicious character,
this Lady Tamamo will catch 'em and beat 'em to a pulp!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
With two regulars accompanying you, we can rest easy.
We shall watch over you from the rear in a small Formation Beta.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for your kindness.
Now then, shall we be on our way?♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
First is right here!
It's a shop both Ines and I are regulars at!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Clothes, toys, and... oh my,
I wonder if this accessory is handmade?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
At the bazaar, besides secondhand goods,
some people also sell handmade crafts~

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I see. Then I shall take this one. Might you be the creator?

text_block_list.name: Bazaar Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...Wait, aren't you Fine Motion?!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was utterly captivated by this piece.
You are truly a wonderful artisan♪

text_block_list.name: Bazaar Clerk
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no!
Th-that's far too much honor for me...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what the... Fine's got like a whole halo
shining behind her back, I swear...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo-san, Ines-san!
My deepest thanks go to both of you as well for gifting me such a wonderful encounter.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: S-So dazzling...!!
Fine Motion continued to gracefully enjoy the bazaar after that. And then—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is it time to wrap up already?
It went by in a flash, huh~.
choice_data_list: You were a dependable escort, huh.
You were a dependable escort, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is it time to wrap up already?
It went by in a flash, huh~.
choice_data_list: You were a dependable escort, huh.
You were a dependable escort, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Thanks to everyone,
I was able to find so many wonderful treasures♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, she really loved that last T-shirt she bought.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What kind did you buy?
Show me, show me~♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I-It was incredible... It had "NOODLES" written on it in huge letters...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right? It's a design you don't see very often,
so it really caught my eye~♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Now this is seriously high fashion.
The local aunties back home would totally love this~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll display it in my room as a keepsake~?
Hehe, bazaar finds really are once-in-a-lifetime encounters!
Fine Motion seemed very happy after enjoying the bazaar together with her friend.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'd love to ask for their help again next time, without a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! Shoppin' is a pretty deep game.
Next time, I'll teach ya even more!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it'd be nice to go shopping
somewhere other than a bazaar next time~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to both of you, I've learned so much more about
this country's shopping culture and etiquette...
Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! Next time, I need to get
more used to this sparkling aura~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah, I guess so...

Her friends were completely overwhelmed
by the majestic presence Fine Motion occasionally radiates.
